note: Plain-English explainers for the deferred census, one per tracker ID. THIS IS THE ONLY COMPOSED CONTENT IN THE CENSUS — everything else is reproduced from docs/tracker.csv as written. These sentences are a working aid for triage and carry no authority: where an explainer and the tracker row disagree, the tracker row is right. They render only in docs/deferred.csv, never in the readable census, so the .md's 'nothing is composed' claim stays true. A row with no explainer renders as a named gap, never as a blank.
